fields.description: Soto Grande places two connected residential towers in Al Hamra, Ras Al Khaimah. Its bridge and shared recreation levels link homes with different outlooks toward the lagoon, golf course and coast. Studios, study layouts and duplex penthouses offer several distinct ways to live here.

overview: Ellington lists 602 homes: Tower I has 313 and Tower II has 289. These are planned totals, not an availability statement.
research.locationNote: Al Hamra Village, Ras Al Khaimah. Views depend on the selected tower, floor and orientation; lagoon, golf and sea outlooks are not guaranteed for every residence.
research.priceNote: Property Finder gives a rounded AED 1m launch guide. No current developer entry allocation is verified; obtain a dated quote for the selected layout.
research.paymentNote: The official schedule adds an AED 3,000 registration fee at booking and a separate 4% title-registration amount on completion. Confirm applicable charges and the selected contract; fees are additional to the property instalments.
research.handoverNote: The investment guide anticipates Q4 2029. Property Finder also forecasts December 2029; neither confirms completed works.
